subject: Can directory_index and user_apps work together?

messages.author: 97be4a58f69e047b
messages.subject: Can directory_index and user_apps work together?
parts:
I use this following configuration and would like to show the index of user home apps. But it seems directory_index  is working for /var/shiny-server/www, but can not work for user ShinyApps. 

Any suggestions to solve this?

Thanks in advance.

run_as shiny;

server {
  listen 3838;
  location / {
    site_dir /var/shiny-server/www;
    log_dir /var/shiny-server/log;
    directory_index on;
  }
  location /users {
    user_apps on;
    directory_index on;
  }
}
